cases.finding: From calendar 2024 to 2025 GEO-reported corporate plus employee-PAC contributions increased from $4.023M to $4.425M, and consolidated revenue increased 8.6% from $2.424B to $2.632B, but operating income fell 16.9%. Separate exact-UEI Treasury obligations rose from FY2024 to FY2025; fiscal and calendar periods differ and corporate subsidiary coverage is not identical. None of these facts establish that contributions or lobbying produced contracts.

analyticRules: Only link entities with legal IDs and documented parent/subsidiary relationships; do not use name-only matching as a confirmed ownership or donation link.
Distinguish corporate independent spending, segregated employee-funded PAC giving, company principals' personal giving, lobbying and dark money; never add incompatible categories.
Use date of reported contribution versus decision/award effective date, not merely election year.
Show awards won AND lost, competing bidders, incumbency, contractor size and agency budget before interpreting outcome changes.
Contract obligations are not realized revenue, cash payments, incremental profits or ROI.
Use matched non-donors and pre/post timing as a test; report confounders, uncertainty and negative results. Never label observational associations as quid pro quo.
Respect FEC contributor-data use restrictions and exclude personal addresses/contact information.
